versions.subject: rules: more sliver rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    TargetImage|endswith: 
        - '\spoolsv.exe'
        - '\notepad.exe'
filter:
    SourceImage|endswith: '\csrss.exe'
condition: selection and not filter

versions.subject: refactor: sliver service rule, fix: FP
versions.detection:
selection:
    TargetImage|endswith: 
        - '\spoolsv.exe'
        - '\notepad.exe'
filter:
    - SourceImage|endswith: '\csrss.exe'
    - SourceImage|contains: 'unknown process'
condition: selection and not filter

versions.subject: fix: FP found in testing environment
versions.detection:
selection:
    TargetImage|endswith:
        - '\spoolsv.exe'
        - '\notepad.exe'
filter:
    - SourceImage|endswith: '\csrss.exe'
    - SourceImage|contains: 'unknown process'
    - StartFunction: 'EtwpNotificationThread'
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: TargetImage IN ("*\\spoolsv.exe", "*\\notepad.exe") NOT (SourceImage="*\\csrss.exe" OR SourceImage="*unknown process*" OR StartFunction="EtwpNotificationThread")
